items.description: reading a SKU's detail through the boundary returns a JSON collection with one entry per location where that sku holds stock (seeded across multiple locations under a unique uuid-suffixed sku, cleaned up after), each entry carrying its location and quantity, read through service and repository against the branch DB

the SKU-detail group-by-location shaping (one entry per location for a sku) lives in the service and the sku-filtered query is the repository's sole ORM touch; the boundary and React component contain no shaping or ORM logic (detail read-path layering contract)
the SKU-detail component renders one row per location showing that location and its quantity via its data-testid seams (client component)

the SKU-detail read projection carries each entry's combined inventory_code through the boundary JSON (seed a record with a known inventory_code under a unique uuid-suffixed key, cleaned up after), read through service and repository against the branch DB
each SKU-detail location entry renders its combined inventory_code beside the location via its data-testid seam (client component)

for a seeded sku whose par_level is NULL (a unique uuid-suffixed sku, cleaned up after), the service maps the absent par_level to an explicit "not tracked" semantic in the boundary JSON (null is a valid state, never a null error), read through service and repository against the branch DB
the SKU-detail par-level region renders the explicit "not tracked" state (not a blank region or a null crash) when par_level is absent, via its data-testid seam (client component)

requesting the detail view for a sku that owns zero stock_records rows at any location (a unique uuid-suffixed sku that no test seeds) returns an empty JSON collection with a success status (200), never a 404 or null error, read through service and repository against the branch DB , absence grounded in observable zero rows, not a SKU registry
the SKU-detail component maps an empty collection to the explicit "No stock for this SKU" state via its data-testid seam, rather than a blank page or a null crash (client component)
